_about: Minimums for eval/quality_gate.py. Set from Phase 4-5 results: judge v2 on claude-sonnet-5 caught 17/17 seeded flaws in every run and got 8-9 of 9 rubric cases; claude-sonnet-5 answers were 29/30 faithful and 29/30 fully correct. Each minimum leaves at most one answer of room for run-to-run noise (about 5% of verdicts change between identical runs).
